resolution: Beat.Timer and GraceEffect.Timer retain absent, derived and explicitly authored safe-integer milliseconds. Matched grace chords use independent per-note requests that must agree by value. Timed partially matched groups retain complete ordered source grace beats to avoid duplicate marks and changed chord membership. Public edits, clears, numeric invalids, chord conflicts and exact pinned consumer output are covered. Fresh independent review and serial integrated gates/probe remain pending; no issue state or solved label changed.
verification: Public valid source regression fails against the previous effect reader and passes with three distinct timer states.
Exact raw source/output facts retain all 14 beat addresses, notes, derived/null flags and explicit safe-integer boundary values; original GP7 timer fixture also passes.
Negative, fractional, nonnumeric and overflowing source values fail strict parsing; invalid public values hard reject even with an allowance.
Focused checks only; root owns full conformance, capability probe and prek.
